title: 언어와 문화: 높임말, 반말, 사투리 이야기
objective: By the end, you can use ten words such as 높임말, 반말, 사투리, and 속담 to talk about language and speaking styles in short sentences.
summary: Ten words for talking about how Koreans speak: polite and casual speech, dialects, proverbs, and expressions.

task.title: Use the right word
task.line: Read each sentence or clue and write or choose the word from this worksheet that fits.

words.meaning: an expression; a set phrase people use
words.exampleMeaning: "Sugohasyeotseumnida" is an expression you use when work is finished.

words.meaning: a proverb; an old saying with a lesson
words.example: "가는 말이 고와야 오는 말이 곱다"는 유명한 속담이에요.
words.exampleMeaning: "Kind words get kind words back" is a famous proverb.

words.example: 부산 친구가 사투리로 말하면 잘 못 알아들어요.
words.exampleMeaning: When my friend from Busan speaks in dialect, I can't understand well.

words.meaning: polite (honorific) speech used to show respect
words.exampleMeaning: Use polite speech with people you meet for the first time.

words.meaning: casual speech used with close friends or younger people
words.exampleMeaning: It's fine to use casual speech between close friends.
The news usually uses standard Korean.
The 'ㄹ' sound is still hard for me to pronounce.

words.meaning: the meaning (of a word or phrase)
words.exampleMeaning: I'm not sure what this word means.

words.meaning: a way of speaking; tone of voice
words.example: 그 직원은 말투가 친절해서 기분이 좋았어요.
words.exampleMeaning: That staff member spoke kindly, so I felt good.

words.meaning: a popular new word or catchphrase
words.example: 요즘 젊은 사람들이 쓰는 유행어를 배우고 싶어요.
words.exampleMeaning: I want to learn the catchphrases young people use these days.

exercises: Choose 높임말 or 반말: ① 회사에서 처음 만난 부장님께는 ____을 써요. ② 어린 동생에게는 보통 ____로 말해요.
Fill in the blank with 사투리 or 표준어: ① 제주도에 가면 처음 듣는 ____가 많아요. ② 아나운서는 방송에서 ____로 말해요.
Write the Korean word for each clue: ① a short, old saying that teaches a lesson ② what a word means ③ how you say a sound
Fill in the blank with one word from this worksheet (clue: a new word or phrase that suddenly becomes popular): 이 ____는 작년에 드라마에서 나와서 사람들이 많이 썼어요.
Choose 말투 or 표현: ① 화가 난 것 같은 ____ 때문에 친구가 오해했어요. ② "괜찮아요"는 여러 상황에서 쓸 수 있는 ____이에요.
Answer in Korean with a full sentence: 친구가 "밥 먹었어?"라고 물어봤어요. 이 말은 높임말이에요, 반말이에요?
answers: ① 속담 ② 뜻 ③ 발음
